description.value: Hokuto Sushi & K-Kimbap is a family-owned restaurant bringing Japanese and Korean flavours to downtown Penticton, with a menu spanning hand-rolled sushi, nigiri, kimbap, and bibimbap. The restaurant emphasizes fresh, daily-prepared ingredients and a made-to-order philosophy. Online ordering with pickup is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists wanting to skip a wait.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, family-owned sushi and Korean food restaurant in Penticton with online ordering and pickup (takeout confirmed). A significant address discrepancy exists: OSM records 786 Westminster Avenue while the website footer lists 101-301 Main Street, Penticton, BC V2A 5B7; the website value is used as more authoritative. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records 786 Westminster Avenue but the website footer states 101-301 Main Street, Penticton, BC V2A 5B7. The OSM node location should be verified against the correct address.
